summary: XPR provides self-ordering technology (kiosks, mobile/QR ordering, staff-facing "linebusting" mobile POS, and order display boards) that integrates with existing restaurant POS systems rather than replacing them, explicitly listing integrations with 15+ platforms including Oracle Simphony, PAR POS (Brink), and "Genius POS (Heartland)." (Scope note: XPR's own marketing claims a direct integration with Genius POS (Heartland); this should be independently validated before being cited in a customer-facing conversation, since it directly names Genius.)

XPR states it serves Burger King, Dunkin', Delaware North, and Aramark among 100+ brands, with deployments across 40+ airports, 10+ national parks, and locations in 10 countries, spanning QSR/fast casual chains, enterprise foodservice/travel concessions, and independent restaurants on legacy POS.

XPR claims operators see a "20%+ lift in average check after deploy" and reduced peak-hour counter pressure, with its kiosks handling up to 600 sustained orders per hour. (Scope note: Vendor-reported performance claim with no independent case study cited.)
